content: GitHub Copilot customization model: custom agents are .agent.md files in .github/agents/ defining persona+toolset; Agent Skills are folders under .github/skills (or .claude/skills) with SKILL.md + scripts/examples, auto-discovered and injected into context when relevant. Custom instructions (AGENTS.md) layer further. This three-tier model (agents/skills/instructions) is the native substrate for building a drafting layer on top of the Copilot SDK and maps cleanly to layered customization (org guidance -> repo knowledge -> writer preferences).
